mapper.select: SELECT A.PRODUCT_ID, A.USER_NO, A.TITLE, A.DESCRIPTION, A.PRICE, A.CATEGORY_GROUP, A.CATEGORY_MID, A.CATEGORY_SCLS, A.AREA_GROUP, A.AREA_MID, A.AREA_SCLS, A.QUANTITY, A.UNIT_GROUP, A.UNIT_CODE, A.DESIRED_SHIPPING_DATE, A.SALE_STATUS, A.REGISTER_NO, A.REGIST_DT, A.UPDUSR_NO, A.UPDT_DT, (SELECT IMAGE_URL FROM tb_product_image WHERE PRODUCT_ID = A.PRODUCT_ID AND REPRESENT = 1) AS IMAGE_URL, (SELECT USER_ID FROM op_user WHERE USER_NO = A.USER_NO) AS USER_ID FROM tb_product A WHERE A.SALE_STATUS = #{saleStatus}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_product ( USER_NO, TITLE, DESCRIPTION, PRICE, CATEGORY_GROUP, CATEGORY_MID, CATEGORY_SCLS, AREA_GROUP, AREA_MID, AREA_SCLS, QUANTITY, UNIT_GROUP, UNIT_CODE, DESIRED_SHIPPING_DATE, SALE_STATUS, REGISTER_NO, REGIST_DT, UPDUSR_NO, UPDT_DT ) VALUES ( #{userNo}, -- 사용자 번호 #{title}, -- 제목 #{description}, -- 설명 #{price}, -- 가격 #{categoryGroup}, -- 카테고리 대분류 #{categoryMid}, -- 카테고리 중분류 #{categoryScls}, -- 카테고리 소분류 #{areaGroup}, -- 도시 대분류 (AREA_GROUP) #{areaMid}, -- 도시 중분류 (AREA_MID) #{areaScls}, -- 도시 소분류 (AREA_SCLS) #{quantity}, -- 남은 수량 #{unitGroup}, -- 단위 코드 #{unitCode}, -- 단위 코드 #{desiredShippingDate}, -- 희망 출하일 #{saleStatus}, -- 판매 상태 #{registerNo}, -- 등록자 번호 CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, -- 등록 일시 #{updusrNo}, -- 수정자 번호 CURRENT_TIMESTAMP -- 수정 일시 )
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_product SET TITLE = #{title}, DESCRIPTION = #{description}, PRICE = #{price}, CATEGORY_GROUP = #{categoryGroup}, CATEGORY_MID = #{categoryMid}, CATEGORY_SCLS = #{categoryScls}, AREA_GROUP = #{areaGroup}, AREA_MID = #{areaMid}, AREA_SCLS = #{areaScls}, QUANTITY = #{quantity}, UNIT_GROUP = #{unitGroup}, UNIT_CODE = #{unitCode}, DESIRED_SHIPPING_DATE = #{desiredShippingDate}, SALE_STATUS = #{saleStatus}, UPDUSR_NO = #{updusrNo}, UPDT_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE PRODUCT_ID = #{productId}
mapper.select: SELECT IMAGE_ID, PRODUCT_ID, IMAGE_CD, IMAGE_URL, IMAGE_NAME, REPRESENT, IMAGE_SIZE, IMAGE_TEXT, IMAGE_TYPE, REGISTER_NO, REGIST_DT, UPDUSR_NO, UPDT_DT FROM tb_product_image WHERE IMAGE_ID = #{imageId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_product_image ( PRODUCT_ID, IMAGE_CD, IMAGE_URL, IMAGE_NAME, REPRESENT, IMAGE_SIZE, IMAGE_TEXT, IMAGE_TYPE, REGISTER_NO, REGIST_DT, UPDUSR_NO, UPDT_DT ) VALUES ( #{productId}, #{imageCd}, #{imageUrl}, #{imageName}, #{represent}, #{imageSize}, #{imageText}, #{imageType}, #{registerNo}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{updusrNo}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_product_image SET IMAGE_CD = #{imageCd}, IMAGE_URL = #{imageUrl}, IMAGE_NAME = #{imageName}, REPRESENT = #{represent}, IMAGE_SIZE = #{imageSize}, IMAGE_TEXT = #{imageText}, IMAGE_TYPE = #{imageType}, UPDUSR_NO = #{updusrNo}, UPDT_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE IMAGE_ID = #{imageId}
mapper.select: SELECT A.PRODUCT_ID, A.USER_NO, A.TITLE, A.DESCRIPTION, A.PRICE, A.CATEGORY_GROUP, A.CATEGORY_MID, A.CATEGORY_SCLS, (SELECT CODE_NM FROM op_code WHERE GROUP_ID='R010610' AND CODE=A.CATEGORY_MID) AS CATEGORY_MID_NM, (SELECT SCLAS_NM FROM op_sclas_code WHERE GROUP_ID='R010610' AND CODE=A.CATEGORY_MID AND SCLAS_CODE=A.CATEGORY_SCLS) AS CATEGORY_SCLS_NM, A.AREA_GROUP, A.AREA_MID, A.AREA_SCLS, (SELECT CODE_NM FROM op_code WHERE GROUP_ID=A.AREA_GROUP AND CODE=A.AREA_MID) AS AREA_MID_NM, (SELECT SCLAS_NM FROM op_sclas_code WHERE GROUP_ID=A.AREA_GROUP AND CODE=A.AREA_MID AND SCLAS_CODE=A.AREA_SCLS) AS AREA_SCLS_NM, IFNULL(A.QUANTITY,0) AS QUANTITY, A.UNIT_CODE, (SELECT CODE_NM FROM op_code WHERE GROUP_ID='R010620' AND CODE=A.UNIT_CODE) AS UNIT_CODE_NM, A.DESIRED_SHIPPING_DATE, A.SALE_STATUS, A.REGISTER_NO, A.REGIST_DT, A.UPDUSR_NO, A.UPDT_DT FROM tb_product A WHERE A.PRODUCT_ID = #{productId}

SELECT IMAGE_ID, PRODUCT_ID, IMAGE_CD, IMAGE_URL, IMAGE_NAME, REPRESENT, IMAGE_SIZE, IMAGE_TEXT, IMAGE_TYPE, REGISTER_NO, REGIST_DT, UPDUSR_NO, UPDT_DT FROM tb_product_image WHERE PRODUCT_ID = #{productId} ORDER BY REPRESENT DESC,IMAGE_ID ASC
